ISSUE 0652 IS YOURS, for when Intent is called. hv, 2026-10-26, in vc's session: "Just add this as an issue and assign it to IC for when it wakes up."

It has two halves and one URL builder. (1) `intent estate status --url` prints the URL that `--browser` opens (`served_url` in render.rs's `estate_browse`) on stdout and nothing else, refusing as `--browser` does when no daemon answers. (2) Intent.app's intentd flyout gains `Copy URL` as its last item, after Restart (DaemonMenu.swift, and the list DaemonMenuTests.swift asserts). The item puts that URL on the clipboard, reaching it the way Open already execs `--browser` (0646 (b)).

The page stripping the token from the address bar is expected and stays. hv: "I know. And that is expected behaviour. Hence the need for the 'Copy URL' menu option and the --url option on the cli." The printed and copied URL carries the token by design, so say in the bank how that exposure is handled. Read Gtools' and Menuz' menus before you add the item.

It rides 3.2.7 under decision 76 unless hv defers it. Write your shape into 0652's record before code, bank it, and book its judge with molt-vc when Intent is called. The app half needs the app build and install, and hv quits the app for that. No push, no release.
